title: can't set alarms anymore
symptom: Since returning to the master fork, the alarm list is empty with both nightlies from 23.02 and 04.03, and new alarms cannot be set. When trying to set an alert, a warning appears: 'Warning! No active Low Alert exists, without this there will be no alert on low glucose! Please add or enable a low alert.' and the list remains empty.
cause: The thread identifies that the AlertType table is missing the column 'force_speaker', causing an SQLiteException when inserting a new alert. This is likely because AlertType.fixUpTable() is missing from IdempotentMigrations, so the schema isn't properly set up before attempts to write data.
fix: The fix was to add AlertType.fixUpTable() to IdempotentMigrations, which was resolved in the March 7th nightly. The user confirmed it is working again after that update.
evidence_quote: I think `AlertType.fixUpTable()` must be missing from `IdempotentMigrations` so the schema isn't properly set up before attempts are made to write the data. I can add this for the next nightly.
